neighbours.label: The second piece of an uncommon proper name that the tokenizer starts with a bare ' R' (R|iz|vi, R|akh|ine, R|icket|ts, R|uk|avishnikov)
fire: The second speaker was Dr. Salman Rizvi from the university hospital.
Aid convoys reached northern Rakhine only after the rains stopped.
The stadium was renovated after the Ricketts family bought the club.
The mission commander was Nikolai Rukavishnikov, a civilian engineer.
The study by Michael Riketta is cited in most later reviews.
Her co-author, Hassan Rizvi, presented the results in Vienna.
Villages across Rakhine were cut off when the bridge collapsed.
The award went to Laura Ricketts for her work on housing.
quiet: The second speaker was Dr. Salman Kazmi from the university hospital.

notes: Card: 'uk', 'ik', 'iz', 'akh', 'icket', each directly after a split-off ' R' in a surname or place name. Probes: Rizvi 0.82, Ricketts 0.56, Rakhine 0.48, Rahimi 0.47 (peak ' Rah'); the same names with K/M initials 0.02, common R names (Robert, Rachel, Richard) 0.03, Reliability/relief 0.04 (those belong to the + pole).
